title: Claude toolkit project profile
description: Optional profile read by the hooks, agents and skills of .claude/. Every field is optional: what is missing is detected from the repository (run `bash .claude/hooks/run-node.sh project-context.js` to see the result).

name.description: Project name used in reports. Default: package.json productName/name, then the folder name.

description.description: One line on what the project is (stack, targets). Default: package.json description.

packageManager.description: Default: package.json packageManager field, then the lockfile, then npm.

stack.description: Force a stack flag instead of detecting it from package.json (true/false, or "auto").

scripts.description: package.json script name for each logical task, or null when the project has none. Default: detected among common names (test, test:coverage, test:e2e, lint, typecheck...).

paths.description: Project-relative folders. Default: detected (src, __tests__|tests|test, <tests>/e2e, src/scss|src/styles|src/css, src-tauri).

coverage.description: Coverage thresholds the test tooling enforces (percent). Informative: the agents report against them.

bundleBudget.description: Bundle size gate in KB (gzip). Default used by the agents: initial JS 200/400, vendor 150/300, total 500/1000.

protectedPaths.description: Globs the pre-edit hook refuses to modify, added to the defaults (lockfiles, dist/**, keystores, generated Tauri files). Prefix with ! to remove a default. .env files and node_modules are always protected.

exclude.description: Globs the post-edit lint hook skips, added to the defaults (dist/**, build/**, coverage/**, vendor/**). Prefix with ! to remove a default.

linters.description: File extension → linter, overriding the detected map. null disables linting for that extension.

conventions.description: Files describing the project conventions that reviewers and generators must read, added to CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / CONTRIBUTING.md when they exist.

notes.description: Short project-specific rules every agent should know (one sentence each).
